notes:
Lines 1–12 attribute a splitting of the extension (*) to the datum s and write the inverse-image and conjugation formulas. The source's conditional parenthesis concerning a lift of u is transcribed as written; no new conditional assertion is added. The inline label is SUR(X), including H's acknowledged source reading, and no intended replacement is proposed. Lines 13–22 use the words non-anodin and anodin, then write a torsor/splitting discussion, the inserted phrase '(pas fidèlement d'ailleurs)', and a diagram introduced by les inclusions. The first capital after torseur sous, the compressed words, and several small strokes remain marked. These are reports of written claims and visible labels, not mathematical verification. No external references, OCR or proof checking were used. No text on the page was treated as a page-to-page continuation beyond the assigned sheet.

Page-specific legibility: the large upper prose and the main formula letters are mostly separated, and the raised phi is clearly visible with its attachment. The lower paragraph is more compressed; the interlinear parenthesis and its long attachment stroke crowd the baseline, while retracing obscures the first capital after torseur sous. The upper paragraph's small two-word group, the words after comme, and the final word ending retain explicit doubts. Slanted baselines make target-scoped boxes necessary near adjacent lines.

Witness comparison: both complete drafts were compared line by line with the source, including their agreed text and formula neighbors. C preserves the source's opening clause order and the short forms chgt, hom., and the words non-anodin and anodin. H rearranges that opening, expands some abbreviations, reads the repeated S subscripts as stars, and explicitly substitutes SRT for source SUR in its main map label. The visible point after ext agrees with H and changes C; the following readable autom. int. agrees with C. The looped l in les changes C's ses, while avec changes H's sur. The X bar/vector mark remains open. Both diagram drafts omit the visible curvature of the upper shaft. Neither witness settles the retained lower-word and punctuation uncertainties. No claims about a larger page sequence or unseen source material are made. Blind audit preserves the compressed opening connective as two whole-span alternatives and marks the possible canceled d-prime at inverse. The single short punctuation stroke after relève u is now read first as a comma, leaving the opening parenthesis possibly unclosed. The target in the lower diagram has a local R/K doubt, and the extra terminal pass at the upper arrowhead is drawn explicitly. There are three diagram objects and two connecting shafts. Other SRT occurrences keep their own visible R. The source’s dépend un choix and literal SUR(X) remain. No mathematical statement was checked in this audit.

legibility: The upright prose is generally readable, with compressed joins in the opening connective, the description of the class, and the terminal coïncid. form. The repeated lowered digit 1 is directly exposed in the relevant formulas and differs from H’s repeated star readings.
root_adjudication: Main reader inspected the full source page and every returned crop. On the endnotes crop, the detached dark point immediately following the t of ext. is visible and retained. The phrase avec les structures is supported by the tall loop and connected es after avec. The upper diagram shaft curves down and right; its source and target are kept with that curvature. Opening words, bar/vector, retraced U, une classe, final coïncid. and uncertain punctuation retain explicit doubt.
